name: freeCodeCamp
summary: A free, nonprofit platform for learning to code, with projects and certifications.
description: freeCodeCamp is a donor-supported nonprofit that teaches coding online. Its courses, projects and certifications are all free: you learn by working through interactive lessons in the browser and building projects, and you can earn verified certifications along the way. It suits complete beginners as well as people moving into web development or related technical roles.
